label: VXLAN
notes: Classic VXLAN on UDP port 4789 (legacy 8472). VXLAN-GPE is out of scope. Every byte of the 8-byte header is claimed: flags at 0, the VNI as a masked 4-byte view at 4-6 (byte 7 masked off and modelled separately as the reserved byte), and reserved bytes 1-3 as a constant-zero exclusion. VTEP addresses and UDP ports are matched with host/port primitives.

fields.label: Reserved
fields.description: Trailing reserved byte after the VNI; zero on the wire.

excluded.reason: reserved bytes 1-3; constant zero on the wire and scapy's classic VXLAN exposes no build kwarg for them (reserved0/NextProtocol belong to the GPE union variants)
